title: ENFORCEMENT RULES OF THE ACT ON SUPPORT FOR THE KOREAN SENIOR CITIZENS ASSOCIATION
full_text:
ENFORCEMENT RULES OF THE ACT ON SUPPORT FOR THE KOREAN SENIOR CITIZENS ASSOCIATION

Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of these Rules is to prescribe matters delegated by the Act on Support for the Korean Senior Citizens Association and matters necessary for the enforcement thereof.

Article 2 (Documents Related to Guidance and Supervision)
(1) The term "matters prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of Health and Welfare, including the investigation period, investigation scope, person in charge of the investigation, and relevant statutes and regulations" in Article 9 (3) of the Act on Support for the Korean Senior Citizens Association means the investigation period, investigation scope, person in charge of the investigation, relevant statutes and regulations, documents to be submitted, precautions, and other such matters.
(2) Documents stating the matters referred to in paragraph (1) shall conform to the standard form determined and publicly notified by the Minister of Health and Welfare in relation to social security benefits.

ADDENDA <No. 418, July 18, 2016>

These Rules shall enter into force on August 4, 2016.
